title: New Baywatch series gets a January premiere date on Fox
summary: The reboot starts on 6 January, after the return of The Masked Singer.
body:
Fox has announced its schedule for early 2027, led by a new version of Baywatch.

The lifeguard drama has its series premiere on Wednesday 6 January at 9 p.m. Eastern time. It follows the start of the 15th season of The Masked Singer at 8 p.m.

Also coming

  • Hell's Kitchen returns with new episodes on 14 January.
  • Murder in a Small Town and Memory of a Killer are back on 1 February.
  • A new drama, The Interrogator, starts on 9 February.
  • Next Level Chef returns on 18 February.

Sources: The Hollywood Reporter, TV Insider.
author: ICONDAILY
